title: The Waste's Show
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing was enraged by Chen Ji's absurd attitude, the cup shattering, war on the verge of erupting

text.content: Ye Qing's demonic path pressure descended like a tangible black tide, pouring toward the ruined teahouse. The surrounding withered grass instantly flattened, debris fragments lifted by invisible force, slowly rotating in mid-air. Several Tianqing Sect outer disciples nearby collapsed to the ground, legs giving out. Yet at the epicenter of this aura that could shatter the soul of a Foundation Building cultivator, Chen Ji slowly lifted the coarse ceramic teacup before him. A "gulp" sound, as the tea entered his throat. His expression could even be described as leisurely.

dialogue.content: "Since Young Lady Ye won't drink this cooled tea, what a waste." Chen Ji wiped the corner of his mouth with his sleeve, his tone filled with regret, "This is Mingqian Queshe I spent half a day searching through the ruins. They say it was once served to the elders of Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Ye Qing felt a throb at her brow. Her pressure had struck a cotton wall, all the oppression dissolved effortlessly by the other party. This feeling was like throwing a full-powered punch into cotton, leaving her uncomfortably suppressed. "You—" She was about to speak when she saw Chen Ji had already leisurely poured her a cup of tea, his movements smooth as water flowing, as if she were not the Demon Path Saintess, but an old friend not seen for years.

dialogue.content: "Since the Saintess has traveled far, why not have some tea first." Chen Ji pushed the teacup forward, smiling harmlessly, "Tea as a substitute for wine, to guide your way. As for the conflicts between Tianqing Sect and the Holy Demon Sect—" He shrugged, "How could a servant disciple like me possibly understand such grand matters?"

text.content: Ye Qing's mouth twitched. In all her years, this was the first time she'd encountered someone so calm while she deployed her demonic path pressure, actually making tea. This was completely beyond her expectations. She glanced at the teacup下意识地, an absurd feeling rising in her heart—could there be poison in this tea? No, she was the Demon Path Saintess, who would dare poison her? But this fellow's expression was so insufferable, she真想一掌拍死他.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" A cold voice came from the other side of the ruins. Su Qingyao arrived on her sword, robes floating elegantly, yet her footsteps faltered the instant she saw the scene inside the teahouse. Her gaze swept between Chen Ji and Ye Qing, finally landing on that teacup. "This is..." Her voice was somewhat hoarse, "Your... suitor?"

text.content: The air inside the teahouse seemed to freeze. Ye Qing's expression instantly became a kaleidoscope—shifting from anger to shock, then to an unbelievable sense of absurdity. She, the great Demon Path Saintess, a killer beyond count, had just been mistaken for... a suitor by a Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple Senior Fellow? Chen Ji's hand pouring tea paused slightly, then continued drinking leisurely as if hearing nothing.

dialogue.content: "Su Sister misunderstands." Chen Ji set down the teacup, waving his hand with an innocent face, "This lady was just passing by asking for directions, and I kindly offered her a cup of tea. Look at her all in black—how inauspicious. How would I dare have any thoughts about her?" He deliberately moved to the side, looking as if he wanted to avoid her like the plague.

text.content: Ye Qing felt her blood pressure soaring. Her demonic path mist surged involuntarily under the drive of anger, yet Chen Ji remained steady as an old dog, even offering her a reassuring smile. That gaze clearly said: "Don't rush, let me finish this performance." Miraculously, she calmed down, wanting to see what other tricks this fellow could pull.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao landed at the teahouse's edge, her gaze scrutinizing Ye Qing alertly. When she clearly saw that face, her pupils slightly constricted. "The Demon Path Holy Sect's Saintess... Ye Qing?" Her voice turned cold abruptly, spiritual energy condensing at her fingertips, "Chen Ji, have you gone mad? Colluding with someone from the Demon Path—do you know this is a major sect taboo?!"

text.content: Behind the distant ruins, several Tianqing Sect outer disciples were secretly watching. They had expected to see the Waste Senior Brother crushed by the Demon Path Saintess in a bloody scene, but instead witnessed a bizarre comedy leaving them gaping. Someone couldn't help whispering: "Did you hear? Su Sister said that was a suitor..." "Is the Waste Senior Brother's taste this wild? Even the Demon Path Saintess..." "Hush! Don't talk nonsense!"

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning and Chen Ji's composure, Ye Qing's heart was struggling intensely at this moment. How should she react?

choices.description: Since she was mistaken for a suitor, she might as well go along with it, using an even more absurd method to disrupt the other party's rhythm, and see how Chen Ji would handle it.
choices.visible_reward: The joy of watching a show

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly covered her lips and laughed lightly, that smile both seductive and playful. She stepped gracefully, sitting beside Chen Ji, and actually lifted that teacup. "Since this sister asked, I might as well admit—" Her voice softened, "I indeed came looking for Brother Chen. After all, men who can catch my eye in this world are few and far between."

choices.text: Watch coldly and let things develop
choices.description: Neither cooperate nor expose the truth, just see how Chen Ji explains himself. What exactly is this waste planning? She wanted to see.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing snorted coldly but did not verbally refute. She wanted to see what tricks this waste could still pull. A servant disciple, facing a Demon Path Saintess and an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, still in the mood to make tea—this composure was somewhat interesting.

"Su Sister, you see—this is the downside of orthodox and demonic paths being irreconcilable." Chen Ji sighed, spreading his hands innocently, "When a Demon Path Saintess comes from far away asking for directions, I kindly offer her a cup of tea, yet you accuse me of colluding with the Demon Path. If this spreads, my title as Tianqing Sect's Number One Waste will be set in stone—I wouldn't even dare help a lady on the roadside."

text.content: Su Qingyao was stunned by this crooked logic. She knew there was something wrong, but Chen Ji's words were precisely unassailable. Ye Qing watched the scene from the side, her mouth twitching slightly. This fellow's thick-skinnedness exceeded her understanding. The great Demon Path Saintess had been reduced to "a lady on the roadside"—should she be angry or amused?

dialogue.content: "You—" Su Qingyao took a deep breath, trying to calm herself. She knew she couldn't let this fellow set her rhythm. "Would a Demon Path Saintess come to such ruins to ask directions without reason? Do you think I'm three years old?" Her gaze sharp as a sword, "Speak, what exactly are you scheming?"

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to speak, a commotion came from the distance. Several Tianqing Sect disciples were running toward this place, the leader shouting excitedly: "Come quick! The Waste Senior Brother has a woman outside! And she's the Demon Path Saintess!" Su Qingyao's expression instantly darkened. Ye Qing's eye twitched. Chen Ji's hand holding the teacup finally paused—this gossip was spreading too fast!

dialogue.content: "Su Sister, let me explain—" Chen Ji had just begun when he was interrupted by Ye Qing.

choice.prompt: The gossip has already spread, Su Qingyao clearly doesn't believe your explanation, and Ye Qing's attitude is also puzzling. Facing such an awkward situation, how will you handle it?

choices.text: Go along and admit the relationship
choices.description: Since it's already unclear, might as well directly admit it. Besides, Ye Qing wouldn't deny it publicly, which would appear more candid instead.
choices.visible_reward: Leave the opponent unable to act
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might be even more mistaken

dialogue.content: "Alright, I admit." Chen Ji set down the teacup, looking seriously at Su Qingyao, "Young Lady Ye and I are indeed... kindred spirits. After all, people who can understand me in this world are rare, and she happens to be one of them. If Su Sister thinks this is inappropriate, you're welcome to report to the elders." He paused, adding, "But I'd suggest Sister Su investigate first before coming to interrogate. What if you've wronged an innocent person?"

choices.text: Turn the tables and question her motives
choices.description: Question why Su Qingyao is so concerned about this matter, using rhetorical questions to disrupt her rhythm.

dialogue.content: "Su Sister, I have a question for you." Chen Ji suddenly dropped his smile, his gaze直视 Su Qingyao, "I'm merely a servant disciple, surely there are far more important people in the sect than me. Why when a Demon Path Saintess arrives, your first reaction isn't to report to the elders, but to come question me?" His tone was calm yet carried layers of meaning, "Could it be that Sister Su... cares about me too much?"

choices.text: Shift the topic to serious matters
choices.description: Stop dwelling on this topic, directly steer the conversation toward the larger situation of the Demon Path invasion, forcing Su Qingyao tocalm下来.

dialogue.content: "Su Sister, now is not the time for this." Chen Ji's expression suddenly turned serious, "For a Demon Path Saintess to personally appear, there must be something significant happening. Rather than interrogating me here, why not listen to what she has to say?" He looked at Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a silent询问, "Young Lady Ye, what do you say?"

Su Qingyao was caught off guard by this sudden counter-question. Her face flushed slightly, then turned to anger: "Who cares about you! I just... just don't want to see sect disciples being used by those from the Demon Path!" Her voice raised several notches, "Don't flatter yourself!"

text.content: The surrounding air suddenly fell silent. Several eavesdropping disciples exchanged glances, their expressions brilliant—Su Sister was... embarrassed into anger? Ye Qing watched this scene and suddenly felt this trip was worth it. She looked at Chen Ji with more playful interest in her gaze: this waste was truly interesting. No wonder he dared cooperate with her, he did have some skills.

dialogue.content: "Alright, alright, Su Sister is right, I'm flattering myself." Chen Ji hastily raised his hands in surrender, his expression as innocent as could be, "Then could we all sit down and listen to what Young Lady Ye has to say? After all, with the orthodox-demonic war approaching, shouldn't personal grudges be set aside for now?"

text.content: Su Qingyao snorted coldly but didn't argue further. She sat down across from Chen Ji, yet her gaze remained vigilantly fixed on Ye Qing. Ye Qing also took a seat on Chen Ji's other side. Thus the three sat around a dilapidated tea table, the scene utterly bizarre. The crowd watching from afar had erupted: "Did you see? The Waste Senior Brother, the Left Protector, and the Demon Path Saintess drinking tea together! What a divine combination!"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing lifted her teacup, taking a light sip. Her gaze越过 Chen Ji, falling on Su Qingyao, when she suddenly laughed lightly. "Su Sister, you keep calling him a waste, but if he truly were a waste—" Her voice carried deep meaning, "How could the great Demon Path Saintess personally make this trip to see him?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words were clearly trying to sow discord between you and Su Qingyao. How will you respond?

choices.text: Use self-deprecation to defuse the awkwardness
choices.description: Take her bait with self-mocking, rendering her provocation toothless.
choices.risk_hint: May cause people to look down on you

dialogue.content: "Young Lady Ye overpraises me." Chen Ji shook his head bitterly, "I'm merely someone who picks up scraps. I just happen to know some things others don't." He sighed, "Like this time—when Young Lady Ye asked directions and found her way to me, what could I do? I couldn't chase her away, what if she bore a grudge?"

choices.description: Don't take her bait, directly point out her purpose, letting Su Qingyao see the situation clearly.

dialogue.content: "Young Lady Ye's words carry interesting implications." Chen Ji set down his teacup, looking at her with a knowing half-smile, "Rather than trying to sow discord between Sister Su and me here, why not directly state your purpose? I know your time is precious, mine is too." His tone was calm yet carried undeniable resolve, "We're all smart people, why bother with these pretenses?"

Su Qingyao's gaze moved between Chen Ji and Ye Qing, her expression complex. She suddenly realized she seemed to have never truly seen through this Waste Junior Brother. His composure before the Demon Path Saintess, his neither servile nor overbearing manner under her interrogation—where was this the bearing a waste should have?

text.content: Ye Qing set down her teacup, a playful smile curling at her lips. "Interesting." Her gaze toward Chen Ji carried more appreciation, "No wonder you're someone I've set my sights on—you're truly no ordinary talent." These words were laden with implication, causing Su Qingyao's brow to furrow even tighter. The surrounding gossip fires burned even brighter, with some already imagining various dramatic plotlines.

dialogue.content: "Young Lady Ye, let's discuss serious matters." Chen Ji coughed lightly, deciding to end this comedy. He took out a yellowed paper from his怀, spreading it on the table. "According to my intelligence, the Demon Path army will launch a full-scale attack on Tianqing Sect in three days." His voice lowered, "And their target isn't the sect itself—it's the Ancient Forbidden Land in the rear mountain."

text.content: Su Qingyao's expression instantly changed. "The Ancient Forbidden Land? You mean the place where—" Her voice cut off abruptly, seemingly realizing something. Ye Qing picked up the conversation: "Correct. What's sealed there is enough to change the entire cultivation world's landscape." Her gaze turned sharp, "Chen Ji knows more than I imagined, which is why I came to find him." The atmosphere among the three tensed sharply, the earlier comedy as if it had never happened.

dialogue.content: "So—" Chen Ji lifted his teacup again, his tone returning to its previous lightness, "Before discussing cooperation, why not finish this tea first? After all, once it cools, it won't taste good anymore." His gaze swept between Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, "If either of you wants to fight, wait until I finish this cup. I have one quirk—I must drink my tea before a fight, otherwise I won't perform well."

text.content: Watching Chen Ji drink tea so leisurely, Ye Qing found that inexplicable anger in her heart miraculously dissipate by half. This fellow from start to finish had never been压倒 by her aura, instead dissolving all her attacks with an almost shameless method. She suddenly understood why the Tianji Record had chosen this person—this fellow's depth of thought far exceeded what he revealed. And Su Qingyao was truly打量 this Waste Junior Brother for the first time, a indescribable feeling rising in her heart.

Outside the ruined teahouse, the gossip continued to ferment. The Waste Senior Brother, the Demon Path Saintess, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow—these three people who shouldn't have had any connection were actually sitting at one table drinking tea. Some had already begun calculating how to spread this news with embellishments, while others keenly sensed the tense atmosphere of an impending storm. Inside the teahouse, Chen Ji had already finished his third cup of tea on his own, his expression as serene as ever, as if the approaching orthodox-demonic war had nothing to do with him. The fate of Tianqing Sect three days from now now hung suspended in this pot of coarse tea.
